newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY O/N RATES RISE TO 22.125 PERCENT. [CORRECTED 09:05 GMT]
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY O/N RATES RISE TO 22.125 PERCENT. [CORRECTED 09:05 GMT]

text.p: Hungary's overnight interbank interest rates rose in what dealers saw as a temporary trend.
O/N rates opened on Tuesday at between 21.25 and 22 percent and moved up to close at 22.125, compared to 21.875 on Monday.

"It's difficult to explain the rise given that the market is liquid and passive repo rates have fallen," said Balasz Varga of Inter Europa Bank, adding that the rise was probably a result of a one-off customer order.
On Monday, the central bank cut four out of five repo rates by 0.5 percent, with the one-week reverse repo falling to 21 percent (corrects number of repo rates affected).
Varga said he expected rates to come down on Wednesday.
